summary: Frontend visual/brand + motion regression test. Homepage loads cleanly with zero console errors. Brand mark is the new two-tone bT (teal b rgb(20,184,184) + charcoal T rgb(63,66,69)) with 'BITNEX TECHNOLOGIES' wordmark — old B-box removed. Primary CTA 'Start a project' is teal (rgb(20,184,184)). Reveal elements finish at opacity 1 (fade-up completes). Ecosystem shows .eco-orbit with 2 rings + svg.eco-lines with 6 dashed paths and 6 node cards. Capabilities section renders 3 cards with teal 01/02/03 numbers and teal check icons. Selected work: 'Systems imagined.' is teal, logistics concept card uses teal ellipse on light-teal background, commerce mini-bars are teal. Portal login shows bT mark; admin login succeeds, /portal sidebar active item 'Overview' + progress bars are teal (rgb(20,184,184)). No rgb(37,99,235) blue found in portal DOM.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'forward.' word in hero H1 is not rendered in teal — the forward. has no class/styling, computed color is rgb(32,38,43) charcoal. Spec explicitly required 'forward.' highlight to be teal. Add an accent class (e.g. .accent { color: var(--accent) }) to that span.

action_items: Apply teal accent styling to the 'forward.' <span> in the hero H1 (e.g. add class 'accent' and ensure it maps to var(--accent) #14B8B8) so it matches the pattern used for 'in sync.' and 'Systems imagined.'
critical_code_review_comments: IntersectionObserver reveals fire correctly — sampled .reveal elements resolve to opacity 1 without user interaction (hero) and once scrolled into view (capabilities/work). Good UX.
Ecosystem visual renders orbit rings + 6 dashed SVG paths as specified — dashed animation intended via stroke-dashoffset @keyframes; visually present in screenshot.
No console errors / warnings / page exceptions on / or /portal — previous lucide-react regression not reintroduced.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Teal rebrand (#14B8B8) verified across CTA, capabilities numbers/checks, work headline accent, logistics concept ellipse, commerce bars, portal sidebar active nav, and progress bars. Old blue rgb(37,99,235) and old B-box are fully gone. Only remaining gap vs spec is the hero 'forward.' span not styled teal — one small CSS/JSX fix in App.js.
